delta_only: This refinement fills the command/caller matrix and binding comparator missing from the existing proposal. It does not replace the prior decision options or implement an authority service. No formal code, Skeleton, behavioral RED or live endpoint work is performed.

what_current_source_proves.fact: authorize(name) rejects disallowed command names but accepts no caller/window/actor identity.
Main and UI editor/viewer capability files include the same dispatch-default set. That set includes start_run, start_implementation, guard_check_start/changes and mutation commands.

spec_approve is registered and invokes host.spec_approve without a caller/human check in its handler. Registration/name allowlisting does not prove authenticated human approval. Runtime Tauri ACL effectiveness for each app command is not independently exercised by this report.

Current EnvelopeDto.approved and RedKindDto::Behavioral are caller data. GuardExecPass contains envelope_hash and optional work_item_id only; it explicitly does not guarantee complete project/revision/evidence authority binding.
SPEC approve locks a revision's contracts fingerprint; that FNV-1a hash covers contract serialization, not full architecture/BDD/skeleton or producer authority.
EVID VersionBinding has spec_hash and worktree_fingerprint. RunCapture can record build_ok, command/cwd/exit/output/cases but is not itself a trusted human or behavioral-failure attestation.
Current start_implementation calls authorize_exec_start on caller GuardPacketDto; start_run accepts an optional packet and can reach ungated path without it.

proposed_trust_boundary.owner: One trusted local desktop operator; no claim to resist hostile same-OS programs, UI automation acting with local user permissions, or compromised trusted frontend code. This restriction must be accepted explicitly.
proposed_trust_boundary.human_only_meaning: Owner confirmation is a host-driven local native confirmation result; a request may ask for a prompt but cannot submit an approved=true response. A window label alone is not human authentication. Native result plus restricted command route supplies a local interaction boundary only, not remote identity proof.
proposed_trust_boundary.minimum_owner_route: Proposed owner_request_implementation_approval is callable only from the locally configured main window. HOST loads the exact candidate snapshot itself, shows task/module/project/fingerprint/artifact hashes/RED verdict and one-shot scope in a native confirmation, then rechecks the snapshot under the dispatch lock before recording approval. Agent tools and UI editor/viewer are denied this route. No confirmation command or native result seam currently implements this contract.
proposed_trust_boundary.no_boolean_authority: Do not accept actor='human', approved=true, red='behavioral', expected hashes or an allowlisted command name as authority. Agent may supply an approval reference, never the bound record or comparator truth.
proposed_trust_boundary.future_Agent_identity_gap: No inbound MCP authentication/caller-to-run binding is established in the inspected path. Future Agent execution/cancel must remain denied until its driving adapter supplies a host-scoped caller identity/session bound to assigned work. Do not invent an identity field in request JSON and call that authentication.
proposed_trust_boundary.no_new_framework: Use existing HOST composition and in-memory session records if owner approves. No DB, network approval service, repository hierarchy or global Manager. Exact local native-dialog integration/tool choice remains a required architecture seam review before Skeleton.

binding_record_PROPOSED.session_and_lifecycle: HOST-owned session_instance + approval_id + status {Approved,Consumed,Revoked}. References from another host boot are unknown. No persistence, expiry clock or automatic retry added. One shot is proposed and requires owner selection.
binding_record_PROPOSED.task: Exact immutable task_id + module_id + authoritative intent=Implementation. Task deletion/reclassification/module change invalidates. Caller title, module label or board color is not authority.
binding_record_PROPOSED.project: Exact WORK project_id plus normalized bound project_root from HOST settings/WORK, not caller fallback. Reject unbound/ambiguous roots. Existing lexical normalization only; no new physical symlink/sandbox claim.
binding_record_PROPOSED.fingerprint: Exact host-resolved current worktree fingerprint. Must identify the intended checkout/working state, not merely caller fp:path; if no trustworthy producer/resolver is selected, approval is NOT_READY. This missing producer is an explicit gap.
binding_record_PROPOSED.architecture_BDD_skeleton: Each category binds explicit artifact manifest: revision_id plus sorted [{project_relative_path, sha256(exact UTF-8/file bytes)}]. No auto-discovery. Missing/duplicate/unsafe path rejects. A rename or any byte change (including comments) makes it stale; no semantic hashing shortcut.
binding_record_PROPOSED.envelope: Bind primary_module, integration_modules, allowed/protected patterns, module-prefix mapping and exact approval scope. SHA256 over deterministic canonical JSON: UTF-8, lexicographic object keys, no optional whitespace; manifest paths slash-normalized and sorted, duplicate paths reject; non-path text is exact, no Unicode/case folding. Protected path wins existing GUARD policy. This manifest contract is proposed, not existing SPEC fingerprint semantics.
binding_record_PROPOSED.RED: Exact host-resolved evidence_id + producer/runner identity + command/cwd + build_ok=true + exit/case failure + stdout/stderr digest + failing test IDs + test-source manifest + qualified behavioral classification + same task/project/fingerprint/artifact bindings. Compile/infra/missing/PASS/empty proof reject. A caller label or RunCapture field alone is insufficient; qualified runner/classifier ownership still must be chosen.
comparator_order: Resolve caller capability and task intent from HOST-owned sources; no external start yet.
Resolve approval reference in current session; require Approved, not Consumed/Revoked.
Resolve authoritative task/module/project/root/fingerprint and bound artifact/RED records. Missing producer/record rejects NOT_READY, not default approved.
Compare every bound dimension exactly; category-specific mismatch reports stale field code, no secret/path outside bound project echoed.
Evaluate unchanged pure GUARD scope/protected-path policy using host-built data.
Revalidate and reserve/mark Consumed atomically under existing dispatch authority lock before EXEC side effects.
Run existing EXEC/WORK preflight/start path; source changes after reservation are outside a writable-session isolation guarantee. No claim to contain hostile same-OS file edits.

failure_revoke_race_contracts_PROPOSED: F1: Actor denied, unknown task intent, missing resolver, missing record, stale binding, invalid RED, revoked/consumed reference or GUARD reject => zero EXEC start, no accepted run/lease/running task/evidence success. Policy preview remains read-only.
F2: Owner declines/closes prompt => no approval created, no intent mutation, no run. Document changes while prompt open => reject stale confirmation; never silently approve current different bytes.

F3: Approved -> Consumed at one successful reservation; concurrent two starts with same reference => at most one reservation/start attempt. Native spawn/transport failure after reservation does not resurrect approval; operator must confirm anew. This is proposed lifecycle, not current behavior.

F4: Revoke before reservation wins and starts zero. Revoke after reservation cannot retroactively undo a child already started; it prevents subsequent reservation, records revoked disposition, and explicit cancel controls the active run. Do not imply cancellation or rollback of external effects.

F5: Revision/envelope/task/project/fingerprint/RED producer record change before reservation => stale; exact rejected dimension named. Restart discards all intent/approval records, so references cannot revive.

F6: Proposed stable codes: AUTHORITY_DENIED, INTENT_UNKNOWN, IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRES_APPROVAL, APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND, APPROVAL_STALE:<field>, APPROVAL_REVOKED, APPROVAL_CONSUMED, RED_UNQUALIFIED, APPROVAL_NOT_READY. Error spelling/API is proposed for owner review, not new current contract.

F7: Trusted frontend/local native confirmation is a scoped interaction model, not an authenticated anti-automation security boundary. If owner requires hostile local-process resistance or remote approval, stop and separately design that stronger authority.

architecture_A1_A14.A1 Context: Trusted local owner, untrusted future Agent adapter, current Tauri windows, HOST, SPEC/EVID/WORK, pure GUARD and EXEC.
architecture_A1_A14.A2 Hexagonal: Diagram A below; real native owner confirmation remains a proposed driving capability, not a domain dependency.
architecture_A1_A14.A3 Dependency: Diagram B below; no GUARD -> UI/FS/OS/network dependency.
architecture_A1_A14.A4 Responsibilities: HOST owns proposed intent/approval session record and authoritative resolution; GUARD owns pure rules; SPEC owns contracts; EVID owns records; WORK owns project/lease; adapters own caller/native interaction.
architecture_A1_A14.A5 Input ports: Existing start_run/start_implementation plus proposed local classify/confirm/revoke commands. Exact surface changes await owner approval.
architecture_A1_A14.A6 Output ports: Reuse existing store reads and EXEC seam; native confirmation and current fingerprint/qualified RED producer resolution are explicit missing seams, not implicitly implemented.
architecture_A1_A14.A7 Driving adapters: Restricted local main/native-confirmation callback; scoped Agent ingress (not implemented); tests.
architecture_A1_A14.A8 Driven adapters: Existing EXEC process/MCP and artifact/runner read seams after approval; no new infrastructure framework proposed.
architecture_A1_A14.A9 Dependencies: Command/caller adapter -> HOST resolved values -> GUARD; HOST -> EXEC only after authority checks. Concrete SDK/native dialog outside pure GUARD.
architecture_A1_A14.A10 State ownership: New proposed session-only HOST intent/approval state explicitly requires owner approval. Views, client DTOs and HTML cannot own authority.
architecture_A1_A14.A11 Mutation: Owner native result may create exact record after snapshot recheck; restricted owner revoke/classify only. Agent reference requests cannot mutate approvals. HOST consumes reservation atomically.
architecture_A1_A14.A12 Transactions: Snapshot/prompt without holding dispatch lock; recheck + approval commit under lock. Start: recheck + one-shot reservation under lock before external call. No claim of OS-wide file atomicity after reservation.
architecture_A1_A14.A13 External boundary: No real Agent/network invoked. Hostile same-OS processes excluded only if owner selects that model. Caller capability and producer provenance not proven by serialization validation.
architecture_A1_A14.A14 Forbidden: Agent-set actor/approved/classification authority; generic bypass; UI-only approved flag; SPEC FNV treated as whole artifact seal; report-to-green; stale pass reuse; direct adapter execution bypass; hidden global authority manager.

diagram_A:
Trusted owner -> restricted main request -> HOST-driven native confirmation [PROPOSED/MISSING]
Untrusted Agent -> restricted input adapter [caller binding MISSING]
        -> HOST input commands -> session approval/intent resolver
        -> pure GUARD rules -> existing EXEC output boundary
SPEC / EVID / WORK -> existing authoritative values, with missing full-binding producers explicitly NOT_READY
Domain GUARD has no native dialog, network or filesystem dependency.
diagram_B:
Local confirmation callback -> HOST session record (new owner, NOT APPROVED)
Artifact manifests + qualified RED runner + WORK fingerprint -> HOST comparator [missing provenance seams]
HOST -> GUARD policy -> EXEC -> existing process/MCP adapters
Future Agent allowlisted query/start-reference tools -> same HOST; never -> confirm/classify/revoke
SPEC contract approval remains separate from implementation authority.

AC2: Every binding has a named authoritative producer and one independently mutated stale case; no caller data silently substituted.

AC5: No approval from client boolean, arbitrary RED label, policy preview or SPEC contracts-only hash.
AC6: No domain infrastructure dependency, new DB/auth framework/Manager; enumerate exact minimal file/API/seam cost before Skeleton.
AC7: Native capability integration and qualified runner provenance independently verified; native UI/Agent NOT RUN until actual evidence exists.
AC8: Architecture and all new semantics approved before formal Skeleton, compiled behavioral RED or production implementation.
